questions.question: The source gave Baire’s death year as 1932 in the heading and 1935 in the introductory list.

localizations.source: The source gave Baire’s death year as 1932 in the heading and 1935 in the introductory list.
localizations.ru: В исходнике год смерти Бэра расходился между заголовком (1932) и вступлением (1935).

questions.resolution: The death year has been harmonized as 1932 using the CTHS directory and University of Burgundy material: https://cths.fr/an/prosopographie_liste.php?page=29&sc= ; https://math.ube.fr/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/PDF-Baire-SMF_.pdf .
